map.下限=75−0.5×60=45；MIP 60>45 不弱；力量目标训练=60×0: Lower limit = 75 - 0.5 x 60 = 45; MIP 60 > 45, not weak; strength target = 60 x 0.35 ≈ 21 cmH2O.
map.MIP<下限→吸气肌薄弱，从 30–50% MIP 起渐进负荷。: MIP < lower limit -> weak inspiratory muscles; start at 30-50% MIP and load progressively.
map.力量 30–50% MIP、耐力 20–30% MIP，每日分次训练。: Strength 30-50% MIP, endurance 20-30% MIP, split into daily sessions.
map.MIP/MEP 反映吸气/呼气肌，低于年龄下限提示易疲劳。: MIP/MEP reflect inspiratory/expiratory muscles; below the age lower limit suggests easy fatigability.
